recent_signals.headline: TAIEX -6.5% Friday, -6.8% on the month but still +15.9% on three months. **The tell of the whole Asian tech move: TSMC posted a blowout quarter — net profit +77%, capex raised to $60-64bn — and was SOLD anyway.** That is a valuation unwind, not a war trade. Taiwan's genuine crisis exposure is helium at **~69% GCC dependence** (higher than commonly reported), against ~30-35% of global supply offline for 3-5 years; TSMC says it expects no significant near-term impact, citing diversified contracts and on-site recycling capex the Korean memory fabs lack. CONFIRMED.
